fields.description: For example Ground, 01 or 02. Repeat a floor on another row to give some of its rooms a different bed setup.
fields.label: Floor Name / Number

fields.description: Prefix applied to generated room numbers, for example 2 generates 201, 202.
fields.label: Room Prefix

fields.description: On a repeated floor, leave 1 to carry on after the rooms of its previous row.
fields.label: Room Start No

fields.description: Single gives one bed per unit. Bunk gives one bed per level of each bunk. Single + Bunk mixes both in one room.
fields.label: Bed Setup

fields.description: Single: number of beds in each room. Bunk or Single + Bunk: number of bunk beds in each room, each giving one bed per Bunk Level. Set 0 for sites that do not use bed level allocation.
fields.label: Beds / Bunks

fields.description: Single beds in each room, numbered after the bunks. For example 2 bunks and 1 single give B01-L, B01-U, B02-L, B02-U and B03.
fields.label: Single Beds

fields.description: 2 gives each bunk a Lower and an Upper bed (B01-L, B01-U). 3 adds a Middle bed (B01-L, B01-M, B01-U).
fields.label: Bunk Levels

fields.description: Beds actually generated in each room: one per level of each bunk, plus the single beds.
fields.label: = Beds

fields.description: Leave 0 to use the number of beds generated for the room.
fields.label: Capacity
